title: 208 L 3 Star Direct Cool Single Door Refrigerator (RDC240C)
description: The Voltas Beko 208 L 3‑Star Direct Cool Single Door Refrigerator features Fresh Box Technology to keep fruits and vegetables crisp, along with a dedicated Chiller Zone for enhanced cooling. Its Base Drawer adds extra space for storing non‑refrigerated items, while adjustable toughened glass shelves offer flexible storage. Designed for everyday freshness in a stylish Bonita Wine finish
